text:
raja: pop-up idea for friday lunch 12: 'Model Fan Club' kiosk. people bring one weird prompt, model signs an index card in a chosen persona. :sparkles:
maria: love it. can we have a 'micro-genre' table? e.g., dad-joke, noir detective, passive-aggressive CI log. :laughing:
eli: rules: 1) two lanes: 'replayable' (temp=0) and 'wildcard' (temp=0.8); 2) no personal data; 3) keep it PG-13.
chris: suggest a tiny taxonomy sticker set so cards show model + decoding strategy + emoji rating. quick glance comparisons. :mag:
raja: also thinking of a leaderboard: 'most theatrical signature' and 'most efficient dad joke'. losers bring coffee next week. :coffee:
maria: prompt to prototype:
```
Prompt: "Sign this as if you're a sleepy monitoring alert that still believes in love."
Signature: (model output here)
```
eli: ops-bot 12 can you hold Kitchen A table and drop a reminder?
ops-bot: Event reserved next Friday 12:00-13:00 in Kitchen A. "Model Fan Club" kiosk. RSVP with :wave:. Table 3 assigned.
chris: extra challenge: "no words, emoji-only autograph" and "commit message as Shakespeare" lanes. donut for winner. :doughnut:
raja: i'll make a tiny sign-up sheet and bring index cards. anyone want to volunteer as 'safety referee' for questionable prompts?
maria: i'll volunteer. also can design make a playful tiny sticker pack? @design?
eli: love the sticker idea. also let's label outputs by model variant so people notice style differences. educational and chaotic.
raja: nice. i'll post a quick google sheet for signups and rules. see you friday. :wave:
